steps.name: Record build: echo launchable verify && echo launchable record build --name ${launch
steps.run:
j2gha_script="$(mktemp "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/j2gha-retry.XXXXXX")"
cat > "$j2gha_script" <<'J2GHA_RETRY_EOF'
echo launchable verify && echo launchable record build --name ${launchableName} --source jenkinsci/jenkins=.
J2GHA_RETRY_EOF
for attempt in $(seq 1 2); do
  rc=0
  bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail "$j2gha_script" || rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" = 0 ]; then break; fi
  if [ "$attempt" = 2 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi
  echo "retrying ($attempt/2)"
done
